claim: T describes matched search suppression in the frozen selected cohort. The stratified cluster resampling measures T's sensitivity to reweighting the observed games. Its central 95% interval is an empirical stability interval, NOT an established confidence interval for repeated L0 designs. GO means enough effect and stability to justify proposing ONE confirmation acquisition, not statistical proof of a population effect.
meaning: GO = sufficient effect and resampling stability to justify PROPOSING ONE confirmation acquisition; not proof of a population effect, and not authorization to acquire anything
